tests: forward migration preserves every existing account, session, staff policy, provider trigger and unrelated function
reservation marks only its fresh UUID, then the real Auth trigger creates an already hidden shell
pending staff cannot reactivate the shell or perform social posts, follows, presence, and RPC writes
user and service-owned Storage upload attempts cannot give a reserved staff shell social media
finish grants the reviewed role while preserving hidden profile and valid AAL1/AAL2 staff operations
finished staff can operate the support desk through the protected server while social writes stay disabled
expired and revoked staff sessions still fail independently of shell deactivation
wrong provider metadata cannot create an active profile or finish a staff reservation
a failed finish leaves the provider-created profile hidden, grants no staff access, and can retry its reservation
replays do not duplicate shell markers, roles, audit entries, or reset the original deactivation time
service metadata edits work, but service or ordinary admin restoration cannot activate a staff social profile
business provisioning stays an active delegated profile and does not acquire a staff marker
existing staff, existing member writes and an older completed reservation retain their original state
shell records and trigger functions deny direct app and service access
ordinary account-erasure and missing-identity fences remain effective after adding the staff boundary
repeat application, unexpected grants and unfinished legacy staff setup fail closed at preflight

profile_trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_staff_social_shell BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION admin_ops.enforce_staff_social_shell()
